candidates.title: AI
candidates.summary: AI: Experience analytics reveals behavior and motivations that traditional analytics miss, enabling more informed conversion and CX decisions.

source_metadata.evidence: The guide states experience analytics shows customer behavior 'between metrics,' combining quantitative and qualitative data to understand behavior and intent so teams are not 'only seeing half the story.'

The document lists these core capabilities and describes features such as reverse-journey analysis, click/scroll/hover heatmaps, session replay for reproducing issues, product-level analytics and AI-driven smart dashboards and alerts.
The Dune London case study reports the team added a wishlist, optimized filters and moved to tabbed guest checkout, resulting in the stated AOV, bounce and conversion changes.
The 'About Contentsquare' section describes the platform as an all-in-one experience intelligence solution and states its insights are used on over 1.3 million websites worldwide.

Contentsquare materials state that experience analytics shows customer behavior between metrics, combining quantitative and qualitative data to understand behavior and intent, and that without it you're 'only seeing half the story' ; the guide also defines experience analytics and its role within an Experience Intelligence platform .
The document lists core capabilities—Journey Analysis, Heatmaps, Session Replay, Merchandise Analysis—and describes AI features like automated insights, smart dashboards, and alerts .

The Dune London case study reports the team added wishlist, optimized filters and moved to tabbed guest checkout; results shown are +14% increase in average order value, -30% decrease in bounce rate and +4% increase in conversion .

Škoda used Contentsquare insights to create a sticky tools navigation; reported results include +40% increase in test drive visits and uplifts to toolkit CTAs (Finance Calculator +10%, Find a Retailer +12%, Car Configurator +3%) .
HARTING used Journey Analysis and Heatmaps, redesigned PDPs with a sticky box and 'Matching Products'; results reported as +38% increase in PDP downloads and +4% increase of all PDP clicks .

Modibodi reordered filter options (raising 'Size'); Contentsquare Heatmaps and analysis showed +122% more revenue per click and an increase of $5.80 to $11.90 revenue-per-click for 'Apply Filters', plus +23% mobile and +5% desktop click rate increases .

About Contentsquare section describes the platform as an all-in-one experience intelligence platform and states its insights are used to optimize the experience on over 1.3 million websites worldwide .

The guide outlines how different teams (digital marketing, product, analysts, ecommerce, UX, engineering) benefit from experience analytics—improving acquisition, prioritizing roadmaps, reducing cart abandonment, surfacing technical issues and more .

evidence.title: Everything You Need to Know About Experience Analytics
evidence.text: We’re focused on a combination of doing the right thing for the customer at the right time. For us, it means moving towards hyper‑personalization, moving away from vanilla experiences and making sure that we’re delighting our customers rather than just serving them with an experience. Brands can do this by simply making the experience easier. There’s a statistic that if you have one bad experience with a brand, you’re 50% less likely to go back to that company. Focus on that customer experience and treat people as an individual and not a number or persona. Make it easy for them to transact or find that thing they’re looking for or whatever it is that they come on your site for.

evidence.text: We’re focused on a combination of doing the right thing for the customer at the right time. Focus on that customer experience and treat people as an individual and not a number or persona. Make it easy for them to transact or find that thing they’re looking for or whatever it is that they come on your site for.
